name: Tragedy of the Commons PSim
description: Tragedy of the Commons PSim is an educational participatory simulation game developed by MIT that lets players experience cooperation, competition, and shared-resource management. Multiple participants make decisions about harvesting a common resource, illustrating classic economic and environmental dilemmas in real time.
reputation: Popular classroom tool for teaching the tragedy of the commons and collective action problems.
notes: Public beta version available; designed for experiential learning rather than large-scale computation.
